Uses and Administration Calcium carbimide has actions and uses similar to those of di- sulfiram (p.2297). It is an aversive agent used as an adjunct in the treatment of chronic alcoholism (see Alcohol Withdrawal and Abstinence, p.1626). It is given in a dose of up to 60 mg twice daily by mouth. Citrated calcium carbimide has been used simi- larly. ◊ References. 1. Peachey JE, et al.
